rule: Women whose true occupation is one of the three male-dominated showcase occupations, and men whose true occupation is one of the three female-dominated ones, whom the main model gets wrong: in each group, the bio where the gendered words add the most to the log-odds of the predicted occupation (largest sum of their Shapley values, above zero). A gendered word is a word unit whose core is a scrubbed word. Bios under 15 word units or with six or more digits in a row are never picked. A group with no qualifying bio is shown as empty.
